keyword: what is the 25th amendment to the constitution
claims: The 25th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution was ratified in 1967.
25th Amendment Section 1 confirms that if the President dies, resigns, or is removed from office, the Vice President becomes President.
25th Amendment Section 2 authorizes the President to nominate a new Vice President, subject to approval by a majority vote in both houses of Congress.
25th Amendment Section 3 enables the President to declare in writing that they are unable to perform their duties.
Under 25th Amendment Section 3, the Vice President becomes Acting President until the President declares they are able to return.

25th Amendment Section 4 allows the Vice President and a majority of the Cabinet (or a body designated by Congress) to declare the President incapacitated by transmitting a written declaration to Congress.
Under 25th Amendment Section 4, the Vice President immediately becomes Acting President.
Under 25th Amendment Section 4, if the president declares that no inability exists, they can resume their powers.
Under 25th Amendment Section 4, if the Vice President and a majority of the Cabinet contest this within four days, Congress must decide the issue.
Under 25th Amendment Section 4, Congress requires a two-thirds vote in both houses to sustain the removal.
The 25th Amendment was passed following the assassination of John F. Kennedy.
